summary: First end-to-end frontend test for the Lovli mobile MVP against the live backend at https://app.lovli.in/api. Login page, login flow, and Reply screen UI all render correctly. Two issues found: (1) bottom tab `tabBarTestID` props are not propagating to the DOM (the visual tabs render fine, but data-testid selectors fail), (2) generate-replies call did not return within 30s on the preview run (Claude was slow and Metro websocket disconnected mid-flight, so reply cards / Copy / Regenerate / usage increment / Feedback POST could not be verified end-to-end). Settings (gear icon) and Memory CRUD flows could not be exercised because navigation depends on the same bottom-tab selectors. No secrets found in client.ts (only EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and Bearer token usage).

ui_bugs.issue: tabBarTestID values ('bottom-nav-reply', 'bottom-nav-pro', 'bottom-nav-memory') do not appear as data-testid on the rendered bottom tab buttons. The custom tabBarButton destructures `testID` from props and forwards it to <Pressable testID={testID} />, but on the web build the prop is arriving undefined. Tabs are still tappable by their text label, but automated tests and screen-reader hooks that rely on testID are broken. Likely fix: read both `testID` and `tabBarTestID` (or accessibilityLabel) from props, or wrap children inside a View with the expected testID derived from the route name.

Tapping Generate replies with empty image and empty manual text did not leave the 'Upload a screenshot or paste the chat first.' toast visible long enough to be observed in a 1.2s post-click scan. Either the toast dismisses too quickly or it is never shown on web. Worth re-checking ToastContext duration and z-index on web.

integration_issues.issue: With manual text 'hey she said she loves matcha cafes', language=English, no image — call did not produce a reply-result-card within 30s. Console shows 'Disconnected from Metro (1006)' during the wait, which may be a preview tunnel quirk, but combined with Claude's variable latency this exceeded the test budget. Could not validate: reply cards rendering, tone label, Copy button -> Copied + toast, /feedback POST, Regenerate, usage counter increment.

issues: Bottom tab bar overlays the bottom portion of the screen as expected; Generate button stays visible with scroll padding. No overlap regressions observed in screenshots.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning on web: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' — non-blocking on web, harmless on iOS/Android. No action needed unless main agent wants to suppress.

action_items: Fix bottom-tab testID propagation in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx so 'bottom-nav-reply', 'bottom-nav-pro', 'bottom-nav-memory' are queryable as data-testid in the DOM (block on this before re-running the suite).
Verify the 'Upload a screenshot or paste the chat first.' toast actually mounts (and stays for ~2s) on web when Generate is tapped empty.
After tab testID fix, re-run end-to-end: generate-replies (allow 45s), Copy → /feedback POST, Pro waitlist submission, Memory add/edit/delete, Settings save + log out via top-right gear icon.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext / endpoints look clean. No hardcoded URLs; EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is used with a sensible fallback.
No secrets ('sk-ant', 'AIza', 'GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET', 'claude') present in the frontend source — only Bearer-token usage. Pass.
Google login is correctly disabled (`disabled` prop on SecondaryButton renders aria-disabled=true).
Reply screen handles plan='pro' (unlimited) and limit==0 edge cases. Good.

Memory delete uses Alert.alert which on react-native-web maps to window.confirm — test harness must register a dialog handler before clicking (which we did). Behavior unverified end-to-end due to tab nav blocker.

success_rate.frontend: ~50% (login + reply UI verified; reply generation, tab nav, Pro, Memory, Settings flows blocked by tab testID + slow LLM)

seed_data_creation: None. Used the existing test user lovli.mobile.test@example.com on the live backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes the tab testID propagation, re-run the full suite. Use mobile viewport 390x844 and the preview URL. Credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Important: the /api/generate-replies call goes to the live production Lovli backend and calls Claude — expect 10-25s latency. Free user has a daily limit of 8 so do not regenerate more than once. Settings opens from the top-right gear icon, NOT a bottom tab. The current logged-in test user has onboarding_complete=true so the login redirects straight to /reply; to test the onboarding screen you may need a freshly signed-up account.
rca_of_issue: Bottom tab testIDs missing: expo-router's <Tabs.Screen options={{ tabBarTestID: ... }}> passes the value through to the tabBarButton via props. In recent expo-router versions, the prop name received in the custom tabBarButton callback is `testID`, but only when the prop is forwarded through React Navigation's internal button wrapper. On react-native-web, the Pressable's testID attribute does become data-testid in the DOM only if it is a non-empty string. The most reliable fix is to derive the testID from the route name inside tabBarButton (e.g. `testID={testID || \`bottom-nav-${route.name}\`}`) or simply use accessibilityLabel as a stable selector. Reproduction: open preview, login, inspect the bottom tab bar in devtools — the Pressable nodes will not have data-testid set.
